lenders.name: Axos Bank - Small Balance Commercial Multifamily Lending
lenders.parent_or_aka: Axos Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AX); formerly BofI / Bank of Internet
lenders.footprint: National (major MSAs with population of at least 250,000 per Axos page)
lenders.property_types: Multifamily (5+ units; other Axos page says 2-200 units), Mixed-use, Investor 2-4 unit, Student housing
lenders.programs: Stabilized and light value-add multifamily, 3/5/7/10-yr hybrid ARMs on 30-yr amortization, Mixed-use, Investor-owned 2-4 unit
lenders.broker_program: Axos runs a dedicated 'Partners' (broker) section for Small Balance Commercial; its multifamily partner page advertises 'premium broker rebates paid'. A 2019 Axos broker marketing sheet also listed 5+ unit multifamily and YSP programs offered nationwide (dated).
lenders.fit_notes: Other desk of Axos Bank - CRE Specialty Bridge & Construction Lending. California-based bank with a documented broker-rebate multifamily program up to $20M / 75% LTV; confirm the unit-count floor (pages say 5+ and 2-200).

lenders.name: Provident Savings Bank (Provident Bank Mortgage)
lenders.parent_or_aka: Provident Financial Holdings, Inc.; Provident Bank Mortgage is a division of Provident Savings Bank, F.S.B.
lenders.footprint: California (Inland Empire / Southern California focus)
lenders.property_types: Multifamily (5+ units), Mobile home parks, Commercial
lenders.programs: Commercial / multifamily 5+ unit portfolio loans (wholesale rate sheet)
lenders.broker_program: Provident Bank Mortgage runs a wholesale channel (pbmwholesale.com). A Provident loan-officer presentation points brokers to a wholesale rate sheet for 'Commercial / Multi-Family 5+ Units', and a Provident Riverside rate sheet dated 2025-04-18 lists multifamily programs up to 75% LTV with a $500,000 minimum on the 'A' program.
lenders.fit_notes: California savings bank with a wholesale (broker) channel that publishes a 5+ unit multifamily rate sheet; good for small-balance Inland Empire / SoCal apartment deals. Rate sheet is April 2025, so confirm current terms.

lenders.name: Malaga Bank
lenders.parent_or_aka: Malaga Financial Corporation
lenders.footprint: Southern / Central Coast California (Santa Barbara to San Diego)
lenders.property_types: Multifamily (5+ units), 1-4 unit investment, Commercial investment, Mixed-use
lenders.programs: Multifamily portfolio loans (purchase, refinance), 1-4 unit investor loans incl. construction, Commercial investment property loans
lenders.broker_program: Not documented. Malaga's lending page lists named income-property lending officers and says it is a portfolio lender that does not sell its loans (local decisions). No broker program found; ask the income property team whether it accepts broker submissions.
lenders.fit_notes: SoCal apartment-focused portfolio lender (multifamily concentration is its core business). Broker acceptance unconfirmed.

lenders.name: JPMorgan Chase - Commercial Term Lending (Multifamily)
lenders.parent_or_aka: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.; absorbed First Republic Bank (2023)
lenders.footprint: National; California teams in Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco
lenders.programs: Stabilized multifamily term loans (Commercial Term Lending)
lenders.broker_program: Not documented. Chase pages describe a direct, streamlined process (LOI on two years of operating history and a recent rent roll; tax returns not required; costs the greater of $2,000 or 12.5 bps of the loan). No broker or referral program found.
lenders.fit_notes: Largest bank apartment lender in California with low closing costs ($500K to over $25M). Brokers can introduce clients, but Chase publishes no broker compensation program, so fee must come from the borrower.

lenders.name: WaFd Bank (Washington Federal)
lenders.parent_or_aka: WaFd, Inc.; acquired Luther Burbank Savings / Luther Burbank Corporation (merger closed March 2024)
lenders.footprint: Western U.S. incl. former Luther Burbank California branches
lenders.property_types: Multifamily (5+ units), Commercial real estate, Single-family
lenders.programs: Multifamily and CRE portfolio loans (legacy Luther Burbank income-property lending)
lenders.broker_program: Not confirmed for 2026. Luther Burbank historically worked with independent mortgage brokers (wholesale). After the merger WaFd sold $2.8B of the acquired multifamily loans (2024); no current WaFd broker program for California multifamily was found.
lenders.fit_notes: Successor to Luther Burbank, once a top-25 U.S. multifamily lender based in California. WaFd shrank the acquired apartment book in 2024, so appetite and broker acceptance need a call.

lenders.name: Pinnacle Real Estate Capital Markets - Small Balance Lending
lenders.parent_or_aka: Pinnacle Financial Partners (PNFP), Nashville; PNFP Real Estate Capital Markets
lenders.footprint: National (originators work nationwide); SBL office in Dallas
lenders.property_types: Multifamily (50 units or fewer under Freddie Mac Conventional Small)
lenders.programs: Freddie Mac Optigo Conventional Small (replaced legacy Optigo SBL on 2026-04-15), legacy Freddie Mac SBL (hybrid ARM, fixed, interest-only options)
lenders.broker_program: Lender page says its originators 'develop relationships with commercial mortgage bankers, brokers and financial institutions nationwide'. Pinnacle was one of about 11 seller/servicers authorized for Freddie SBL and was selected as a seller/servicer for the new Conventional Small program.
lenders.contact_title: SVP, Head of Multifamily SBL team
lenders.licenses: Freddie Mac Optigo Small Balance / Conventional Small Seller/Servicer
lenders.fit_notes: One of only ~10-11 Freddie small-balance seller/servicers and openly works with brokers; good outlet for 5-50 unit California apartments at agency pricing (loans under $10M). If the 2025 Pinnacle-Synovus merger closes (not verified in this round), this desk is still separate from the known Synovus Senior Housing Group.

lenders.name: Veleta Capital Partners (VCP)
lenders.parent_or_aka: Veleta Capital; launched 2022 as a JV with Oaktree (minority stake); Veleta Fund II anchored by TriPost Capital Partners (May 2025)
lenders.footprint: National, focus on Western U.S. and Sunbelt
lenders.programs: Senior secured transitional / bridge loans (floating and fixed), renovation and ADU-conversion bridge
lenders.max_leverage: 68% LTC on a cited Dallas deal
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program, but 2023 deals were announced as brokered by outside intermediaries (Bellwether Enterprise arranged a Dallas loan). Press contact press@veletacapital.com per the TriPost release.
lenders.fit_notes: Los Angeles-based small-balance apartment bridge platform (loans up to $20M) with California deals such as a $12.6M Northridge 42-unit renovation; takes intermediary-arranged deals. Confirm broker fee policy directly.

lenders.name: The Bancorp Bank - Real Estate Bridge Lending (REBL)

lenders.broker_program: Not documented. Product page targets investors in value-add multifamily nationwide; no broker page found.
lenders.fit_notes: $2.2B apartment bridge book funded on a bank balance sheet (no warehouse line), $2M-$60M+. California activity and broker acceptance unconfirmed; a 2025 class action concerns its Sun Belt syndicator loans.

lenders.broker_program: Not documented.

lenders.name: AGM Financial Services

lenders.fit_notes: California wholesale DSCR lender with a current (March 2026) 5-8 unit matrix; useful for very small apartment buildings that agency and bank lenders will not do. Covers only 5-8 units, not larger small-balance deals.

lenders.fit_notes: Wholesale non-QM lender with a published 5-8 unit and 2-8 unit mixed-use DSCR product for brokers. HQ, state licensing and California lending not confirmed in searches.
